# Cadence
> Fast, local-first daily planner for students and independent learners.

Cadence brings together your class timetable, daily habits, focus timer, tasks, and notes in one fast, private app. No ads, no tracking, and it works completely offline.

## Core Capabilities
- Class timetable with 24-hour visual schedule and iCalendar (.ics) export
- Daily habit loops with Duolingo-style flame streaks and freeze shields
- Offline Pomodoro focus timer with zero-bandwidth procedural ambient noise (brown noise, rainfall)
- Homework and assignment kanban board
- Markdown scratchpad notebook with math formulas
- Offline student utilities: GPA target calculator, radix/base converter, unit converters, AES-GCM credential vault
